content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a collision involving the challenger's footed covenant-origin chain by citing the challenged sentence's own words, so it does the thing the rule governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"Phrase 'the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse': I weighed whether the judge's reliance on 'the sentence's own words' is a forbidden verse-by-verse test or a permitted chain-footing comparison.","why":"Because the judge acknowledges the challenger's chain is footed but then treats the challenged verse's own wording as decisive, it does not weigh the two chains by footing as K-C requires."}
